commitResults.messageTitle: Add Task class, as well as mark and unmark methods to both the task class and the Echo class
commitResults.messageBody:
Done to finish Level-3 while following OOP principles like encapsulation.

Changing the list in the TodoList class to hold Tasks instead of just
strings containing task names. Adding attributes like whether the task
is done, and task description to the Task class.

This allows polymorphism later when more Task types are added.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add ability to add various tasks like deadlines, todos and events. Change method names to camel case
commitResults.messageBody:
Changes made to satisfy requirements for Level 6 and better fit coding standards.

Making subclasses of task to make use of polymorphism and reduce redundant code.
Change start method to accept more commands like deadline, todo and event

commitResults.messageTitle: Add custom exception class to handle invalid commands and print a message Add error handling for to do list commands which are invalid or do not provide description
commitResults.messageBody:
Changes are to handle invalid inputs and fulfill requirements for Level 5

Add custom exception class which extends IllegalArgumentException to
handle invalid commands
Add try catch blocks to relevant to do list related methods
to catch invalid inputs for to do list commands and to the
start method to catch invalid commands

Add delete task method to todo list class which deletes task with
the provided index from ArrayList containing tasks.

ArrayList used to provide an easy and efficient way to remove list
elements and shift list elements to the left as necessary.
